summary_md: **zn-gate ([@use_zn](https://x.com/use_zn/status/2116600802227687885))** opened the weights of **Galvanize 3**, a ~140M multilingual prompt-injection classifier under Apache-2.0 that runs on CPU and catches 89.6% of attacks at 0.6% FPR on their 3,309-example test set ([usezn/Galvanize-3](https://huggingface.co/usezn/Galvanize-3), [blog](https://usezn.com/blog/galvanize-3-weights-are-now-open/)).
relevance: Local prompt-injection filter for agent pipelines.
